method: Label-aware InfoNCE + reconstruction + DER++ (random AugMix views)
contrastive_loss: all 3N anchors; average log-probability of two same-entry views; two same-entry positives and only different-class views in denominator
positives: two other views of same batch entry
negatives: only views from different-class batch entries; other same-class views excluded
duplicate_policy: same-class duplicate entries are excluded from each others denominators; only same-entry views are positives
reconstruction_target: each view reconstructs its own input; clean->clean and augmented->augmented
reconstruction_loss: pixel MSE averaged over 3N examples and all RGB pixels; symmetric encoder/decoder gradients
decoder: 128->128x4x4 linear ReLU; transpose-conv 64,32,3; sigmoid output; no BN
weights: independent per example and view, freshly sampled
bn: joint original/view1/view2 forward, then separate replay-logit forward
architecture_provenance: SmallCNN copied unchanged from reproduce/metamix_long.py; normalization wrapper added
